sn8.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhatelasehi bhikkhusatehi || || 2.
sn8.8:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti ||
sn8.8:1.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhi-katvā manasi katvā sabba-cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammam suṇanti || || 3.
sn8.8:1.4: Atha kho āyasmato Vaṅgīsassa etad ahosi || ||
sn8.8:1.5: Ayaṃ kho Bhagavā bhikkhū nibbāna-paṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti ||
sn8.8:1.6: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhi-katvā manasi katvā sabba-cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti || ||
sn8.8:1.7: Yaṃ nūnāhaṃ Bhagavantam sammukhā sarūpāhi gāthāhi abhitthaveyyanti || || 4.
sn8.8:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsam uttarā saṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten-añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn8.8:2.2: Paṭibhāti maṃ Bhagavā paṭibhāti mam Sugatā ti || || 5.
sn8.8:2.3: Paṭibhātu taṃ Vaṅgīsā ti Bhagavā avoca || || 6.
sn8.8:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgīso Bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sarūpāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi || ||
sn8.8:7.1: Kinnu te Vaṅgīsa imā gāthāyo pubbe parivitakkitā udāhu ṭhānaso va taṃ paṭibhantī ti || || 8.
sn8.8:7.2: Na kho me bhante imā gāthāyo pubbe parivitakkitā atha kho ṭhānaso va maṃ paṭibhantī ti || || 9.
sn8.8:7.3: Tena hi taṃ Vaṅgīsa bhiyyosomattāya pubbe aparivitakkitā gāthāyo patibhantū ti || || 10.
sn8.8:7.4: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Vaṅgīso Bhagavato paṭissutvā bhiyyosomattāya Bhagavantam pubbe aparivitakkitāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi || ||
